description.value: Canadian Classic Pizza Ltd. is a community pizza restaurant that has been serving the Abbotsford area since 2007. The menu is notably diverse, blending classic Canadian toppings with South Asian-inspired options like Paneer, Palak Paneer, and Shahi Paneer pizzas, plus gluten-free crust available on request. Cyclists can dine in or take out, with delivery also available.
